experiment_data.hypothesis: α=0.5 (minimal overlap suppression) should produce pruning similar to standard importance-only, predicting GSM8K accuracy near standard 20% (~59.84% GRPO). Combined with α=4.0 (62.77%) and α=1.0 (54.43%), establishes dose-response curve for overlap suppression strength.

spec.command: nohup bash pipeline (prune α=0.5 → SFT → GRPO → eval_gsm8k×2)
